proposition: Existing governed pilot sleep and circadian candidates
reason: BIO-F01 science and B01-B05 were already governed; no new exact route is needed.

proposition: A single cortisol marker is equivalent to allostatic load
reason: Multisystem cumulative construct cannot be replaced by one acute biomarker.

proposition: Subjective thirst is equivalent to objective hydration status
reason: Homeostatic drive and body-fluid state are different levels.

proposition: Ambient heat universally increases heat strain
reason: Exposure, achieved strain, acclimation and dose differ; exact controlled contrast not extracted.

proposition: Chronic exercise universally reduces physical fatigue
reason: Exercise packages, baseline health and measured energy/fatigue differ.

proposition: Controlled endotoxin increases acute sickness response intensity
reason: Small male laboratory studies and scale/biomarker alignment prevent broad BIO-030 assertion.

proposition: Age-related hearing loss causally reduces broad cognitive capacity
reason: Observational association and test-access differences do not identify causal direction.

proposition: Oral iron supplementation reduces BIO-025 physical fatigue in low-ferritin nonanemic adults
reason: Trials measure reported general fatigue; BIO-025 physical fatigue is not isolated, while objective capacity differs.

proposition: Thyroid replacement universally reduces fatigue in older adults
reason: Controlled trials in mild subclinical hypothyroidism show no clear fatigability benefit; no universal direction.

proposition: Measured frailty causes measured physical fitness decline
reason: Frailty scoring shares constituents with fitness measures; direction not identified by association.

proposition: Polygenic risk score directly causes an acute biological state
reason: Predictive aggregate profile is not a direct acute mechanism or manipulation.

proposition: Any traumatic brain injury causes uniform persistent cognitive impairment
reason: Severity, domain, course and recovery vary; no exact uniform endpoint.

proposition: Any alcohol effect universally reduces bodily capacity
reason: Working-memory task meta-analysis does not identify broad physical capacity and has dose/task moderation.

proposition: Abrupt blinded cessation of habitual caffeine raises time-bounded withdrawal severity
reason: Controlled substitution studies establish symptom changes but do not establish one exact, transportable BIO-066 whole-syndrome severity metric; incidence and symptom composition vary.
